title: Figure 8: Specific Power vs Plasma Temperature of Fusion Rocket (D-3He, D-T)
description: Line graph of specific power (kW/kg, 0-12) versus plasma temperature (keV, 0-200). Three curves are labeled 'D-3He Long-Term' (dash-dot, peaking near 10 kW/kg), 'D-3He Mid-Term' (solid, peaking near 5 kW/kg) and 'D-T Mid-Term' (dashed, near zero). Caption: 'Figure 8. Specific Power as a Function of Plasma Temperature of Fusion Rocket'.
